Lemma
[The Wedge of Wedges of Covectors]

↗ def:wedge-alternating-forms ↗ def:wedge-covectors ↗ lem:laplace-expansion-block

\[ (f_1\wedge \cdots \wedge f_k)\wedge (g_1\wedge \cdots \wedge g_l)=f_1\wedge \cdots \wedge f_k\wedge g_1\wedge \cdots \wedge g_l. \]
Proof

↗ lem:laplace-expansion-block \sketch Evaluate on a tuple. The left side is the block Laplace expansion of the determinant defining the concatenated wedge (Lemma lem:laplace-expansion-block).

□
